## Analysis

## **Define the primary hypothesis**

**Research question:** Does gene expression differ between tumour and normal breast tissue?

## Loading libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```

## Without shifting

### Creating the data frame for linear models

#### Creating the long augment data

We need to create the long augment data so that have all the genes defined in one column. This way we are able to group the data by gene. The clean augment data should contain genes instead of probes.

Keeping only the gene, and expression

```{r}
dat_clean_aug <- dat_clean |>
  select(-probe_id)
```

```{r}
dat_clean_aug_long <- pivot_longer(data = dat_clean_aug ,
                                       cols = starts_with("GSM"),
                                       names_to = "sample", 
                                       values_to = "expression")
```

#### Distribution of expressions

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(dat_clean_aug_long,aes(x=expression))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of gene expression",
    x = "Expression",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
p1
```

There are a lot of genes with low expression

#### Adding the state column

```{r}
dat_clean_aug_long <- dat_clean_aug_long |>
  mutate(state = case_when(
    metadata_aug$tissue_group[match(sample, metadata_aug$sample_id)] == "Tumour" ~ 1,
    metadata_aug$tissue_group[match(sample, metadata_aug$sample_id)] == "Normal breast" ~ 0
  ))
```

Checking if there is a state with NA value

```{r}
table(dat_clean_aug_long$state, useNA = "ifany")
```

Keeping only genes and expression

```{r}
dat_clean_aug_long <- dat_clean_aug_long |>
  select(-sample)
```

Making sure everything is in the right format

```{r}
dat_clean_aug_long <- dat_clean_aug_long |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
    state = as.numeric(as.character(state))
  ) |>
  relocate(state)
```

```{r}
glimpse(dat_clean_aug_long)
```

#### Group by gene

Creating a dplyr pipeline, using the group_by() function to group dat_clean_aug_long dataset by gene and then adding the nest() to the pipeline.

```{r}
dat_clean_aug_long_nested <- dat_clean_aug_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |>
  tidyr::nest()
```

### Model

#### Creating and tidying the model object

Using the map()-function, adding a new line to the pipeline, where we add a new variable model_object to the dat_clean_aug_long_nested dataset, which R will compute per gene.

### Creating the model object then the tidy model object

```{r}
dat_clean_aug_long_nested <- dat_clean_aug_long_nested |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    model_object = map(
      data,
      ~lm(expression ~ state, data = .x)
    ),
    model_object_tidy = map(
      model_object,
      ~tidy(.x, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)
    )
  )
```

#### Estimates for the data

```{r}
dat_estimates <- unnest(dat_clean_aug_long_nested, model_object_tidy)
```

```{r}
dat_estimates
```

Keeping only the 5 columns that we need.

```{r}
dat_estimates <- dat_estimates |>
  filter(term == "state") |>
  select(gene_id, p.value, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
dat_estimates
```

#### Examine significance

We check whether a gene is significantly differentially expressed between the two conditions.

```{r}
dat_estimates <- dat_estimates |>
  mutate(
    q.value = p.adjust(p.value),
    significant = q.value < 0.05
  )
```

```{r}
dat_estimates
```

```{r}
dat_estimates <- dat_estimates |>
  mutate(
    q.value = p.adjust(p.value),
    is_significant = case_when(q.value <= 0.05 ~ "yes",
                               q.value > 0.05 ~ "no")
  )
```

```{r}
dat_estimates
```

```{r}
dat_estimates <- dat_estimates|>
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),
    significant = p_adj < 0.05,
    label = if_else(significant, gene_id, "")
  )
```

### Visualizing data

```{r}
ggplot(dat_estimates,
       aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(p.value))) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = significant),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#F8766D",
               "TRUE" = "#00BFC4")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

-   estimate = tumour expression - healthy expression

The plot shows that more differentialy expressed genes are underexpressed in diseased genes than in healthy genes.

## With shifting and log2() transformation

### Shifting and log2() transforming the data

```{r}
shift <- 1 - min(dat_clean_aug_long$expression, na.rm = TRUE)

dat_clean_aug_long_transformed <- dat_clean_aug_long |>
  mutate(expression_log2 = log2(expression + shift))
shift
```

#### Exclude the original expression

```{r}
dat_clean_aug_long_transformed <-dat_clean_aug_long_transformed|>
  select(-expression)
```

#### Distribution of expressions - shifted, log2() transformed

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(dat_clean_aug_long_transformed,aes(x=expression_log2))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of gene expression",
    x = "shifted log2(expression)",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
p2
```

### Group by gene

```{r}
dat_clean_aug_long_transformed_nested <- dat_clean_aug_long_transformed |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |>
  tidyr::nest()
```

## Model

### Creating and tidying the model object

```{r}
dat_clean_aug_long_transformed_nested <- dat_clean_aug_long_transformed_nested |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    model_object = map(
      data,
      ~lm(expression_log2 ~ state, data = .x)
    ),
    model_object_transformed_tidy = map(
      model_object,
      ~tidy(.x, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)
    )
  )
```

### Examine significance

```{r}
dat_transformed_estimates <- unnest(dat_clean_aug_long_transformed_nested, model_object_transformed_tidy)
```

```{r}
dat_transformed_estimates <- dat_transformed_estimates |>
  filter(term == "state") |>
  select(gene_id, p.value, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) |>
  ungroup()
```

### **Correcting for multiple testing**, using the **Bonferroni correction**

```{r}
dat_transformed_estimates <- dat_transformed_estimates|>
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),
    significant = p_adj < 0.05,
    label = if_else(significant, gene_id, "")
  )
```

## Visualizing data

```{r}

ggplot(dat_transformed_estimates,
       aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(p.value))) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = significant),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#F8766D",
               "TRUE" = "#00BFC4")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

We got similar results as for the expression without shifting and transforming.
